operating_notes.text: Reported Q4FY26 net profit of ₹281.97 Cr with Gross NPA at 2.26% and Net NPA at 0.43%.
Microfinance group loan PAR 90+ at 3.4% and individual loan PAR 90+ at 2.7% at Mar-2026; West Bengal group loan PAR 90+ 3.0% and Karnataka 6.3%.
Book yield 22.0% overall at Q4FY26, with micro banking at 22.2% and non-micro banking at 12.4%.

Gold loans, vehicle finance and agri banking grew 292%, 102% and 127% YoY and now contribute around 6% of the loan mix against 3% in FY2025.
Cost of funds was 7.0% for Q4FY26 and 7.2% for FY26; LCR 142% and CD ratio 89% at March 31, 2026.
Q1FY27 loan book growth was about 29% YoY with GNPA at 2.2% and the secured book share above 50%.

Bucket X collection efficiency was 99.7% in Q2FY27, in line with Q1.
